active_slot=A
previous_slot=B
upgrade_available=0
bootcount=0
bootlimit=3
rollback_from=none
# Disable U-Boot's autoboot countdown so the appliance boots straight into the
# kernel (saves the compiled-in 2 s "Hit any key to stop autoboot" wait before
# SD-card activity begins). Because a seeded environment REPLACES the compiled
# defaults rather than layering on top of them, this value is authoritative.
#
# Trade-off: with bootdelay=0 the U-Boot console cannot be interrupted at boot.
# To regain an interrupt window for U-Boot debugging, raise this value (e.g.
# bootdelay=3) and rebuild the image; keep it in sync with the required
# `bootdelay=0` check in post-image validation and the buildroot swupdate test.
# On a running device you can temporarily override it with `fw_setenv bootdelay 3`
# (reboot to apply) and restore with `fw_setenv bootdelay 0`.
bootdelay=0
scriptaddr=0x05400000
kernel_addr_r=0x00080000
bootcmd=fatload mmc 0:1 ${scriptaddr} boot.scr; source ${scriptaddr}
